name: EPIC 249796233

text.card: A red giant 2,451 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.67 solar masses and 13.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,850 K at its surface.
